user_query: My company is organizing an outdoor team-building event. Can you recommend some exciting activities for us? Also, find a venue with a large outdoor space and facilities for team activities. Additionally, I need to send out event reminders to all the participants. Provide me with a short URL for the event reminder.

TaskList.description: Research and recommend exciting outdoor team-building activities suitable for corporate events.
Find a venue with a large outdoor space and facilities capable of accommodating team activities.
Create an event reminder message to be sent to all participants.
Send out event reminders to all the participants via email or other communication channels.
Generate a short URL for the event reminder to facilitate easy sharing.
